subject: [PATCH v8 05/30] riscv: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch adds PMD swap-exclusive helpers for the RISC-V architecture, allowing a PMD-mapped anonymous THP to be kept mapped across a swap round-trip. The new helpers wrap existing PTE ones and reuse the _PAGE_SWP_EXCLUSIVE flag, enabling efficient handling of swap operations in PMDs.
